full_details: The second leaf has no name, no number, and no person at the head. It is dated the last of January, 1594. At dinner the fish was threepence. Alse said the loaf wants a finger. You did not name an owl, and you did not set anything beside the horn. The Shrew at two is not yours. Grecian Comedy is the Rose. You did not go to either. The sentence to Anne is still unsent. The packet is not this. You did not write it, and you did not lay Sunday's gift out early.
one_sentence: You stayed in, wrote a second leaf, and ate fish.
title: Wrote a second leaf and ate fish
